title: C3MATERIALIZE L0 through L4 deliverable contracts and checkpoint sequence

x-rule24.domain: emission and declaration populations for each receiver field after the deterministic rerun
x-rule24.grain: one receiver field across 42 manifest parts
x-rule24.intent: report home_space, grain, key, and failure_mode independently; never sum receiver counts into a progress numerator
x-rule24.mece: within each receiver, declared plus unknown equals 42 and emitted equals 42; summation across receivers is explicitly prohibited
x-rule24.state_coherence: a source, admission, or transformation change may move only the receiver fields whose independent readiness axes become satisfied

x-rule24.domain: independent preconditions for moving one receiver from unknown to declared
x-rule24.grain: one receiver over the exact 23-card W4 candidate population
x-rule24.intent: separate source-payload completeness, registry admission, schema-bound transformation authority, and compiler implementation readiness
x-rule24.mece: each axis has its own exhaustive state vocabulary; multiple axes may be blocked simultaneously and no single fate-class value hides that conjunction
x-rule24.state_coherence: admitting cards changes only registry_admission_state; authoring a source field changes only source_payload_state; governing a transform changes only transformation_state; implementing its execution changes only compiler_implementation_state

x-rule24.domain: terminal declaration treatment of the 42-part manifest population
x-rule24.intent: separate current-directive terminal unknown from remediable unknown and already-carded-but-incomplete inputs
x-rule24.mece: 36 cardable plus 3 unbuilt plus 3 L1-resolved equals 42 with no overlap
x-rule24.state_coherence: unbuilt moves to cardable only when the part is built; L1-resolved moves to declared only after complete admitted receiver inputs and a schema-bound transformation exist

x-rule24.intent: separate execution standing from object existence verdict
x-rule24.mece: not_run, completed, and failed cover execution outcomes; this proposal snapshot is not_run
x-rule24.state_coherence: an attempt moves not_run to completed or failed; a retry creates new evidence

x-enum-definitions.not_run: No validation has run against the current shared-schema bytes.
x-enum-definitions.failed: Validation ran and at least one binding condition failed.
x-enum-definitions.passed: The complete declared validation suite passed against the pinned shared-schema bytes.

x-rule24.grain: one schema byte identity and validation-suite version
x-rule24.mece: not_run, failed, and passed are disjoint and exhaustive
x-rule24.state_coherence: schema byte or suite changes reset to not_run; execution moves to failed or passed

x-rule24.grain: one identity space and evidence vintage
x-rule24.intent: separate observed counts from defensible denominators
x-rule24.mece: adjudicated means a scoped denominator exists; unresolved means a named discriminator blocks it
x-rule24.state_coherence: new external evidence may move unresolved to adjudicated without changing prior observations

x-rule24.measured_snapshot_requires: two observed source populations at one measurement event, including an oracle outside the producing pipeline

x-rule24.domain: card admission populations consumed by distinct compiler operations
x-rule24.intent: keep W3 map enrichment admission independent from each receiver-source admission
x-rule24.mece: extension, grain, key, and failure_mode are separate named populations; membership may overlap across populations because consumers are independent
x-rule24.state_coherence: a card enters only the population whose exact completeness predicate and transform pin pass; no directory discovery mutates any population

x-rule24.domain: current W4 card candidate ceiling and its warrant
x-rule24.intent: separate observed files and subjects from governed target, issued deliverable requirement, issued schema binding, lane-selected validation, surprise-channel handling, and future issuer work
x-rule24.mece: each field is one independently measured dimension; a passed lane-selected schema validation does not manufacture an issued card requirement or registry admission
x-rule24.state_coherence: a future TO changes requirement and schema-binding states only; producing missing cards changes counts only; registry admission is outside this candidate record

x-enum-definitions.working_tree_filesystem_view: The source is a live filesystem enumeration whose exact member set was not serialized.
x-enum-definitions.working_tree_untracked: The source artifact existed in the working tree but was not admitted to Git authority.
x-enum-definitions.ignored_device_local: The source artifact was intentionally excluded from Git and existed only on the measuring device.

x-rule24.domain: persistence standing of one measured source population
x-rule24.grain: one source artifact at the measurement event
x-rule24.intent: separate live enumeration, untracked artifact, and intentionally ignored device-local evidence
x-rule24.mece: each source has exactly one persistence standing at the measurement event
x-rule24.state_coherence: admission to Git creates a new source-evidence vintage rather than rewriting the historical standing
